description: A trimmed dispatch plan (fz-sc8.44) keeps the shared plan's outcome ids, so ExecutableDispatch.clause_index_by_outcome and EntryReachability.clauses() map outcomes to clauses. Renumbering outcomes densely in the trim would let both go. Four places depend on dense outcome ids: outcome bindings, receive's return code, ControlDispatch's outcome table, and the clause map. Expected: one renumbering, made in the trim, read by all four; the two maps are deleted.
title: Outcome ids are dense, and clause_index_by_outcome goes
